reddit.detail: RETIRED 2026-07-20. Reddit blocks unauthenticated JSON: old.reddit.com 403 and www.reddit.com 403, tested live with a browser User-Agent. No REDDIT_CLIENT_ID exists anywhere in the repo, so no request this system can make will succeed. The endpoint fix in 9bc2849 (old.reddit + raw_json=1) was correct code against a door that is shut. Reviving this source requires a registered OAuth app and oauth.reddit.com — not a code change here.

value.regime_read: ES & NQ moving together — broad agreement, more DURABLE directional signal. Trust the direction more.
value.narrative:
Macro backdrop —
[2026-07-31] US economic state (FRED):
  Growth: real GDP 1.5% (q/q ann)
  Inflation: CPI 3.23% YoY | core CPI 2.25% | core PCE 3.03% (Fed target 2%)
  Labor: unemployment 4.2%
  Rates: fed funds 3.63% | 10Y 4.67% | 10Y-2Y 0.45% (NORMAL)
  Consumer: UMich sentiment 44.8 | VIX 20.66

---
Recent market action has seen both ES and NQ moving together, indicating a broad agreement in the market. The lead-lag analysis shows that there is no clear leader or follower between the two indices, with the best correlation observed at lag -1 day. This suggests that any directional move will likely be durable and should be trusted more. However, the regime classification remains in 'BREADTH', meaning both indices are moving together without a clear concentration of buying or selling pressure. The volume profile indicates accumulation zones around 7433.96 for ES and 28020.67 for NQ, with these levels acting as support points that could invalidate any directional bias if broken. The upcoming FOMC PCE data is scheduled to be released today at 8:30 ET, which will likely drive market sentiment. Given the current regime and the lack of clear catalysts, a long-the-dip bias seems appropriate with a probability of ~65%, invalidated below 28,375 for NQ.
